map scale-up while the pin label counter-scales: the "vertigo" beat on the destination
fast horizontal blur between two cities or two products (comparison cut)

photo split into foreground/background bands moving at different speeds
route line racing through a whole day with a clock counter
zoom through a boarding pass / receipt / label hole into the next scene
pin circle → sun/lantern circle in the photo, price tag → shop sign
silence + black frame before the verdict
two trips or two products running side by side on one clock
easing curves: slow on arrival, fast between stops
freeze on the decision frame with a stamp
sky color day→night over a photo, calendar pages to D-day
